description: This file defines the JPA entity 'ReportParameterUsage' which models the association between a report and a report parameter within the Fineract data queries infrastructure.

classes.name: ReportParameterUsage
classes.description: Entity representing the usage of a report parameter within a specific report, including its parameter name.

methods.name: hasIdOf
methods.description: Checks if the entity's ID matches the provided ID.

methods.name: hasParameterIdOf
methods.description: Checks if the linked parameter's ID matches the provided parameter ID.

methods.name: updateParameterName
methods.description: Updates the name of the report parameter.

methods.name: getReportParameterName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the report parameter.
